title: Conversation log
note: Every spoken turn: what was heard, what SQL it became, how it went (ai_utterance).
rows: how much has jon smyth spent with us
John Smith has placed 3 orders totalling 4,216 dollars.
and what did he order last time
Order A-1010 on the 14th, delivered, 875 dollars.
do we have any more of those mowse things
Did you mean the Wireless Mouse?
sql: SELECT u.turn_no, u.transcript, u.asr_confidence AS asr, u.intent_name, u.sql_status, u.row_count, u.response_text, u.latency_ms AS ms FROM ai_utterance u ORDER BY u.spoken_at DESC, u.turn_no
